task_description.overview: Interpolate channel positions along an optical fiber cable using known channel-numbered points and optional track points to constrain cable geometry.
steps: Load known channel points (longitude, latitude, channel number).
Load optional track points (longitude, latitude) to define cable path.
Interpolate channel positions at specified spacing (dx) along the path.
Back-project interpolated UTM coordinates to WGS84 (longitude, latitude).

task_definition.agent_prompt: Interpolate DAS channel locations. Input: known_points array with [lon, lat, channel], optional track_points array with [lon, lat], and spacing dx. Convert to UTM, perform linear interpolation along the path at spacing dx, then convert back to WGS84. Output: array of [longitude, latitude, channel_number]. Finally, scatter plot the interpolated channel locations and the track points. Save the interpolated channel locations to {interpolated_points_file} and the plot to {interpolated_points_plot}.
